'''November 2001 Mansfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mansfield, Ohio on 24 November 2001. [[Alex George]] won it. It is known from Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3120">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-25-mansfield-oh-11-24-feel-good-rockd3120/ mansfield-oh-11-24-feel-good-rock], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 25 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-25-mansfield-oh-11-24-feel-good-rockd3120/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Mansfield, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex George]]
